# homeassistant_assist_pipeline (Resource)

An Assist pipeline (Settings > Voice assistants): the conversation agent, speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and wake word that a voice assistant uses. Which pipeline is preferred is `homeassistant_preferred_assist_pipeline`. Home Assistant refuses to delete the preferred pipeline.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A voice pipeline: Home Assistant's own intents first, then an LLM conversation agent, with
# speech-to-text and text-to-speech from Wyoming servers (Whisper and Piper).
resource "homeassistant_assist_pipeline" "home" {
  name                  = "Home Assistant"
  language              = "en"
  conversation_engine   = "conversation.ollama"
  conversation_language = "en"
  prefer_local_intents  = true
  stt_engine            = "stt.faster_whisper"
  stt_language          = "en"
  tts_engine            = "tts.piper"
  tts_language          = "en_US"
  tts_voice             = "en_US-lessac-high"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `conversation_engine` (String) Conversation agent: an entity such as `conversation.home_assistant` (the built-in agent) or an LLM's conversation entity.
- `conversation_language` (String) Language the conversation agent uses, e.g. `en`, or `*` for an agent that handles every language.
- `language` (String) The pipeline's language, e.g. `en`.
- `name` (String) Display name, e.g. `Home Assistant`.

### Optional

- `prefer_local_intents` (Boolean) Whether commands Home Assistant understands itself ("turn on the lights") are handled locally before the conversation agent is asked. Defaults to `false`.
- `stt_engine` (String) Speech-to-text engine, e.g. the `stt.` entity of a Wyoming faster-whisper server. Unset, the pipeline takes no speech.
- `stt_language` (String) Language for speech-to-text, e.g. `en`.
- `tts_engine` (String) Text-to-speech engine, e.g. `tts.piper`. Unset, the pipeline doesn't speak.
- `tts_language` (String) Language for text-to-speech, e.g. `en_US`.
- `tts_voice` (String) Text-to-speech voice, e.g. `en_US-lessac-medium`.
- `wake_word_entity` (String) Wake word engine for streaming wake word detection in Home Assistant, e.g. a `wake_word.` entity. Satellites that detect their wake word on the device don't use it.
- `wake_word_id` (String) Wake word the streaming engine listens for, e.g. `ok_nabu`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Pipeline ID, assigned by Home Assistant. Import with this ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a pipeline by its ID, for example the one onboarding creates. The IDs are in the
# `assist_pipeline/pipeline/list` WebSocket command's reply.
tofu import homeassistant_assist_pipeline.home 01jexample0pipeline0id00000
```
